title: Rollout Signal Panel & Variant Delta Explorer
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a unified Console surface — the Rollout Signal Panel — that lets PMs/Engineers quickly understand the behavioral delta between variant populations during canary and A/B experiments. This work creates an interactive Variant Delta Explorer that shows per-route metric diffs, percentile latency band comparisons, traffic-weighted effect-size estimates, and one-click trace linking into the distributed trace system. The panel should support shadow-traffic overlays and programmatic auto-rollback triggers based on composite signals.
acceptance_criteria: Panel exposes per-route metrics for selected rollout: request rate, 50/90/99 latency, error rate, token-consumption rate, and generation quality score
Delta view shows side-by-side percentile histograms and a statistically-informed effect-size with confidence intervals
Trace linker: user can click any anomalous bucket to open a filtered trace query in the Trace UI with the cohort filter pre-applied
Supports shadow traffic overlay so users can compare live production vs shadowed responses on the same chart
A/B weight timeline lets users select two snapshots and view drift across chosen metrics with exportable CSV
Auto-rollback rule editor in panel allows creating simple policies (thresholds, sustained window) and preview of impacted traffic routes
Telemetry is instrumented: all panel queries are logged, and user selections generate reproducible query IDs for incident triage
E2E tests validate UI rendering, latency of queries under 5s for 14-day windows, and correct trace-link filters
implementation_notes: Backend: add /api/rollouts/{id}/variant-delta endpoint that returns pre-aggregated metric deltas by route and percentile
Use existing telemetry store (Clickhouse) with materialized views for 1,3,14-day windows to keep response <5s
Frontend: new React panel under Console -> Rollouts. Use existing charts library with percentile band support and diff color palette
Trace linking: encode cohort filters as trace query params; collaborate with Trace team to standardize filter grammar
Shadow overlay: render semi-transparent overlay for shadow traffic; include sample response comparison modal for flagged requests
Auto-rollback: integrate with rollout-control API to create conditional rollback policies; require two-step confirmation for destructive actions
rollout_plan: MVP behind feature flag for internal teams (SE + Solutions) - alpha release
Collect feedback for 2 weeks, iterate on key UX flows (trace linking, drift visualization)
Beta release to customers with opt-in for advanced telemetry export
GA after SLA and performance tuning; document guardrails for auto-rollback rules
telemetry_requirements: Instrument query performance metrics for the new endpoint (p50,p90,p99, error-rate)
Emit query_id and user_id with every panel request for correlation in logs
Record snapshot comparisons and policy evaluation outcomes for audit and reproducibility
Add metric tags: rollout_id, variant_id, route, customer_id
